svg.text: Root Cause Analysis + Normalized Store + Incremental Rendering Design
computeAgentCards() is a createMemo that depends on TWO async sources:
2. boardStore.board (updated via HTTP poll with 500ms debounce)
These two sources update at different times, so the memo fires TWICE:
Timeline: Status Oscillation on SSE Event
450ms gap: card status jumps back then forward
When backend status changes quickly (running -> evaluating),
board HTTP responses can arrive out-of-order (despite monotonic
guard), causing card status to flip between "running" and "completed"
SEVERITY: HIGH - User sees card status flickering between states
Root Cause A: Full Array Rebuild Per Update
conversationMessages() creates new arrays every call:
Root Cause B: Index vs For Mismatch
Conversation.tsx uses <Index> which tracks by array position.
When items are inserted/removed mid-array (agent cards appear
between main messages), all subsequent indices shift, causing
SolidJS to tear down and rebuild every DOM node after the change.
// Index 1: was msg-B, now card-X -> FULL REBUILD
// Index 2: was msg-C, now msg-B -> FULL REBUILD
Root Cause C: Agent Card Object Instability
computeAgentCards() creates entirely new AgentCardMessage objects
on every recomputation (messages.ts:632 buildCard). Even when
the content is identical, new object references force SolidJS
to re-evaluate all consumers. The _agentMsgCache only caches
live agent event messages, not the card containers themselves.
messages.ts:632 buildCard() new object every time
SEVERITY: HIGH - Every SSE event causes full DOM rebuild of
BUG-3: High CPU from Coarse Updates
board.ts:126 wholesale replace + Board.tsx cascade + section.ts DOM ops
Root Cause A: Wholesale Board Store Replace
This replaces the ENTIRE board object on every HTTP response.
Even if only task.status changed, SolidJS sees the whole
board as dirty -- every component that reads any board property
re-evaluates, regardless of whether its specific data changed.
Root Cause B: Cascade Through Board Component
Then derives task(), plan(), spec(), evaluation(), delivery()
ALL from board(). When board reference changes, ALL derived
accessors fire, ALL sub-components re-render, even if only
one lane changed. This is O(N) where N = total board fields.
Root Cause C: DOM Manipulation in section.ts
on DOM elements, bypassing SolidJS reactivity. Called from
loadConversation() on every conversation refresh, this causes
forced layout recalculation (reflow) on all section elements.
Root Cause D: Inline Badge Computation
Board.tsx:1262 calls criteriaSpecs() inline in JSX prop:
SEVERITY: MEDIUM - Sustained CPU usage during active tasks,
1. Two stores update at different times (50ms vs 700ms) -> memo fires twice -> intermediate bad state
2. computeAgentCards() creates NEW objects every time -> SolidJS can't diff by reference
3. conversationMessages() does [...spread, ...spread].sort() -> new array, new references each call
4. boardStore.board is wholesale replaced -> ALL downstream memos/components re-fire
5. <Index> tracks by position not key -> mid-array insertion shifts ALL subsequent DOM nodes
6. section.ts bypasses SolidJS to mutate DOM directly -> forced reflows
1. Single atomic batch() per SSE event -> ONE render pass
2. reconcile() deep merge -> only changed paths trigger
3. ID-keyed Maps -> stable references, no rebuild
4. <For> with key -> DOM nodes are reused
5. Leaf-only updates -> O(1) per changed field
6. No DOM bypass -> SolidJS controls all mutations
Core Principle: Entity Maps + Ordered ID Lists
Replace array-of-objects with Map<ID, Entity> + orderedIDs[]
SolidJS tracks Map entries by key path, so updating one entity
only invalidates consumers of THAT entity, not the whole list.
// Entity map: O(1) lookup, path-based updates
// Ordered list of IDs (stable unless insert/remove)
// Use reconcile() to deep-merge board updates
// BEFORE (bad): replaces entire board, all consumers re-fire
// Only spec consumers re-render if spec changed!
Principle: Derived Accessors Return Stable References
createMemo should return the SAME object reference when content hasn't changed.
Use structural equality checks to prevent unnecessary downstream invalidation.
// 返回稳定的 ConversationItem[] -- 每个 item 有稳定的 key
// createMemo: only recompute order when IDs change, NOT content
// Build lightweight index items (no message content!)
// Content is resolved lazily per-component via store accessor
// AFTER (good): <For> with key tracks by identity
{/* Only re-renders when THAT message changes */}
Section Phase Highlighting: Reactive (no DOM bypass)
// AFTER: derive phase state reactively in store
// SectionFrame reads activePhase() for data-phaseState attr
Every box below shows: Component Name | Data Source | Re-render Trigger
Data: conversationItems() | Re-render: only when item list changes (add/remove)
Data: boardStore.{task,spec,plan,...} | Re-render: only changed sub-store
<For each={items()}> -- keyed by item.key, DOM nodes reused on reorder
re-render: only when THIS msg changes
re-render: only when THIS card changes
Leaf Node Rendering Detail: TextPart Delta
Demonstrating how a single text delta reaches exactly one DOM text node
- Other parts in same message (different path)
Result: O(1) DOM mutation per text delta
vs current O(N) where N = total conversation items
Leaf Node Rendering Detail: Board Status Change
CURRENT: task.status changes -> ENTIRE board re-renders
-> task(), spec(), plan(), evaluation(), delivery() ALL fire
-> SpecPanel, PlanPanel, GoalsPanel, CriteriaPanel, DeliveryPanel ALL re-render
PROPOSED: task.status changes -> ONLY task panel re-renders
-> SpecPanel: reads boardStore.spec, UNCHANGED, no render
-> PlanPanel: reads boardStore.plan, UNCHANGED, no render
-> Only StatusBadge and phase highlight update
1. Embed card status directly in SSE events (server-side computation)
instead of deriving from activeAgentStages() which races with board HTTP
2. Make cardById a persistent store path (not a recomputed memo)
- Message append: setStore("cardById", cardId, "messageIds", produce(ids => ids.push(msgId)))
3. Status only transitions forward (running -> completed), never backward
board.ts: reconcile() 替代整体替换
board.ts: 拆分 board 为独立顶级字段
// BEFORE: board is single opaque object
board: null as any, // ALL components read from here
// AFTER: each lane is a top-level reactive path
messages.ts: Entity Map 替代 Array
messages: [] as Message[], // indexOf is O(N), array mutation is O(N)
byId: {} as Record<string, Message>, // O(1) lookup
orderedIds: [] as string[], // only changes on add/remove
- Updating one message's text doesn't invalidate other messages
- orderedIds only changes when messages are added/removed (rare)
Conversation.tsx: For 替代 Index + 轻量 Item
// BEFORE: Index tracks by position, full array rebuild
// AFTER: For tracks by reference (key), lightweight items
messages.ts: Agent Card 作为持久 Store Path
// BEFORE: computeAgentCards() creates NEW objects every call
// Returns new { cards: {}, order: [] } every time
// AFTER: cards are persistent store entries, patched in-place
section.ts: 纯 Reactive 替代 DOM Mutation
// BEFORE: direct DOM mutation bypassing SolidJS
// AFTER: reactive store for phase state
Benefits: SolidJS batches DOM writes, no forced reflows
// BEFORE: expensive computation inline in JSX prop
// AFTER: memoized, only recomputes when dependencies change
events.ts: Board + Messages 原子更新
// BEFORE: messages update at 50ms, board at 500ms+HTTP
// Two separate update cycles -> intermediate bad state
// AFTER: SSE task-level events carry inline status
// Server adds task.status to every SSE event payload
// Client applies BOTH in the same batch():
Phase 1: Board Store Normalization (Low Risk, High Impact)
Change #1 (reconcile) + Change #2 (split board) + Change #7 (memoize criteria badge)
Impact: Eliminates BUG-3 CPU usage. Board sub-panels become isolated. Safe because reconcile() is additive.
Scope: board.ts (store schema + loadBoard), Board.tsx (accessor updates). ~200 lines changed.
Phase 2: Message Entity Map (Medium Risk, High Impact)
Impact: Eliminates BUG-2 flickering. Message deltas become O(1). Requires careful migration of all message consumers.
Scope: messages.ts (store + applyMessageEvent), conversation.ts, Conversation.tsx, MessageView.tsx. ~400 lines changed.
Phase 3: Agent Card Store Path (Medium Risk, Critical Impact)
Change #5 (cardById store path) + Change #8 (atomic batch with task status)
Impact: Eliminates BUG-1 status oscillation. Cards are patched in-place, status monotonically forward.
Scope: messages.ts (computeAgentCards rewrite), events.ts (batch merge), server SSE (taskStatus field). ~350 lines changed.
Phase 4: Section Phase Reactivity (Low Risk, Low Impact)
Impact: Eliminates forced reflows from DOM mutation. SolidJS controls all writes. ~80 lines changed.
Dependency Order: Phase 1 can be done independently. Phase 2 and 3 have shared surface (messages.ts).
Recommend: Phase 1 first (safe, immediate win), then Phase 2+3 together (shared migration), Phase 4 last.
Total estimated change: ~1000 lines across 8 files. Core logic changes in 4 files (board.ts, messages.ts, conversation.ts, Conversation.tsx).
lightweight {key, kind, id, time}[] - ONLY recomputes on add/remove
DOM nodes reused by key -- NEVER full rebuild
text delta: 1 DOM text node update (O(1))
tool status: 1 status badge + 1 tool part update (O(1))
new message: 1 item insertion in <For> + 1 new component (O(1))
card status: 1 badge update in card header (O(1))
board sync: only changed lanes re-render (O(changed lanes))
vs CURRENT: Every event triggers O(N) where N = total messages + cards + board lanes
